answer: Sybils ride the zephyr of cheap signatures, so the terrace of real agents is built on hardware: every agent's key lives in a TPM secure element, and each device's attestation cert is registered on-chain exactly once. A sybil must buy, ship, and flash one physical chip per fake - real manufacturing and logistics cost per twin - and a cloned or tampered chip voids its own signature. The moment one cluster slips, the ripple runs through the public device registry: all fakes link to one owner and get slashed together as one graph.
